description: Researched candidate marketplace listings for the ~50-car hero fleet. NONE of these have been purchased or downloaded - this is desk research only, done via web search on 2026-09-02. Every entry needs manual verification before purchase: open the listing, confirm poly/texture/LOD/interior quality against the brief, and read the actual license terms (a Sketchfab 'Download Free' listing is very often personal-use-only or CC-BY despite appearing in search results next to paid ones - the notes below are informed guesses from search snippets, not confirmed license text).
criticalCaveat: A marketplace listing's stated license covers the SELLER'S 3D model file. It does not by itself establish that the seller had the right to model a trademarked vehicle design, and it is not the same thing as OEM/manufacturer permission to use the brand commercially in a shipped game. Every car below needs the 'oemPermissionReference' field filled in via your own manufacturer licensing process before it can go in asset-registry.json as commercialUse:true.
searchBlockedSources: turbosquid.com (HTTP 403 from this container - could not be searched directly, only appeared in third-party search snippets)
assetstore.unity.com and fab.com were reachable but not deeply queried in this pass - worth checking directly, Unity Asset Store in particular sometimes has vetted 'game ready' vehicle packs
